Notes: New variable pushed to prod on 5/28/26: If GeoNORC_PrecisionMatch_v1r0 = 'Street' then geocoder matched address to an address-level point; if = 'Intersection' then geocoder matched address to an intersection point; if = 'ZIP' then geocoder could not identify address-level match, but matched a ZIP code centroid, if = 'City' then geocoder could not identify address-level match, but matched a city centroid; if = 'Street Segment' then Geocoder could not identify address-level match, but used a street-centroid match; If = 'None' then no match was identified
